isPartialPaymentAllowed.description: This parameter contains any of the following: true-The part payment is enabled  false-The part payment is not enabled

maxPaymentsAllowed.description: This parameter is used to specify the number of payments that can be accepted on a link.

isAmountFilledByCustomer.description: This parameter is set to true to if the amount has to be entered by your customer in the payment link page.

minAmountForCustomer.description: This parameter contains the minimum amount a customer needs to pay in case of partial payment.

subAmount.description: This parameter must contain the payment amount.

description.description: This parameter must contain the description or purpose of creating the.payment link.

invoiceNumber.description: This parameter contains the unique string which is used for identifying a payment link. This must be alphanumeric.

expiryDate.description: This parameter contains the expiry date of the payment link. This must be in yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format (will be 365 days in all other cases).

tax.description: This parameter contains the tax amount for the payment transaction. This value must be greater than zero.

source.description: This parameter contains the source of payment generation.

currency.description: This parameter contains the currency used for collecting the amount.

udf1.description: User-defined fields (udf) are used to store any information corresponding to a particular transaction. You can use up to five udfs in the post designated as udf1, udf2, udf3, udf4, udf5.

udf2.description: User-defined fields (udf) are used to store any information corresponding to a particular transaction. You can use up to five udfs in the post designated as udf1, udf2, udf3, udf4, udf5.

udf3.description: User-defined fields (udf) are used to store any information corresponding to a particular transaction. You can use up to five udfs in the post designated as udf1, udf2, udf3, udf4, udf5.

udf4.description: User-defined fields (udf) are used to store any information corresponding to a particular transaction. You can use up to five udfs in the post designated as udf1, udf2, udf3, udf4, udf5.

udf5.description: User-defined fields (udf) are used to store any information corresponding to a particular transaction. You can use up to five udfs in the post designated as udf1, udf2, udf3, udf4, udf5.

viaEmail.description: This parameter is set to 1 to send the payment link via the email upon generation. Else, set to 0 (zero) so that email is not sent.

viaSms.description: This parameter is set to 1 to send the payment link via the SMS upon generation. Else, set to 0 (zero) so that SMS is not sent.

shippingCharge.description: This parameter must contain the shipping charges if any,

Customer.title: Customer
Customer.description: The customer details in a JSON format.

name.description: This parameter must contain the customer name.

email.description: This parameter must contain the customer email.

phone.description: This parameter must contain the customer phone number.

Address.title: Address

line1.description: This parameter contains the 1st line of the address.

line2.description: This parameter contains the 2nd line of the address.

city.description: This parameter contains the city in the address.

state.description: This parameter contains the state in the address.

zipCode.description: This parameter contains the zip code or PIN code for the address.

Address.description: This parameter contains the customer address to which the goods are delivered.
